mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cc.contract_name, (select ci.description from hls_cashflow_item ci where ci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item and ci.cf_type=ccc.cf_type) cf_item_desc, sua.user_id, ccc.times, ccc.due_amount, ccc.due_date FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_penalty_profile_dtl pp , sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND pp.penalty_profile = cc.penalty_profile AND pp.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and ccc.write_off_flag not in ('FULL') and sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id and fea.employee_id = cc.employee_id AND (TO_DAYS( ccc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) IN (30,14,7) union all SELECT distinct fc.contract_name, (select ci.description from hls_cashflow_item ci where ci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item and ci.cf_type=fqc.cf_type) cf_item_desc, sua.user_id, fqc.times, fqc.due_amount, fqc.due_date FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc, fct_contract fc, ( SELECT cwo.cashflow_id, ct.penalty_calc_date FROM csh_write_off cwo, csh_transaction ct WHERE cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id ) t , sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fqc.cf_item IN ( 54, 55 ) AND ( t.cashflow_id = fqc.quotation_cashflow_id OR fqc.quotation_cashflow_id != t.cashflow_id ) AND fqc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' and sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id and fea.employee_id = fc.employee_id AND ( TO_DAYS( fqc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) IN ( 30, 14, 7 ) GROUP BY fqc.quotation_cashflow_id

SELECT DISTINCT cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, (select ci.description from hls_cashflow_item ci where ci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item and ci.cf_type=ccc.cf_type) cf_item_desc, ccc.times, ccc.due_amount, ccc.due_date, ccc.principal, ccc.interest, hbm.bp_name, cc.company_id FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_penalty_profile_dtl pp , hls_bp_master hbm WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND pp.penalty_profile = cc.penalty_profile AND pp.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and ccc.write_off_flag not in ('FULL') AND cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id AND (TO_DAYS( ccc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) <=#{maxDays} AND (TO_DAYS( ccc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) >=0 union all SELECT distinct fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, (select ci.description from hls_cashflow_item ci where ci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item and ci.cf_type=fqc.cf_type) cf_item_desc, fqc.times, fqc.due_amount, fqc.due_date, fqc.principal, fqc.interest, hbm.bp_name, fc.company_id FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc, fct_contract fc, ( SELECT cwo.cashflow_id, ct.penalty_calc_date FROM csh_write_off cwo, csh_transaction ct WHERE cwo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id ) t , hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project_bp fpb WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fqc.cf_item IN ( 54, 55 ) AND ( t.cashflow_id = fqc.quotation_cashflow_id OR fqc.quotation_cashflow_id != t.cashflow_id ) AND fqc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' AND fc.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND ( TO_DAYS( fqc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) <=#{maxDays} AND ( TO_DAYS( fqc.due_date ) - TO_DAYS( now( ) ) ) >=0
GROUP BY fqc.quotation_cashflow_id
